About the Position

The Max Planck Artificial Intelligence Network recruits new doctoral researchers through a joint process with ELLIS. A single application can be considered for both calls. MP-AIX funding is for new positions and does not cover candidates already employed in a prospective advisor's group.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Machine learning
  • Doctoral research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD research position
Stipend / salaryApprox. €3,010/month gross (TV-L E13, 65% — typical doctoral level)

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsJoint recruitment with ELLIS; reference letters due 2 November; existing employees in prospective advisor groups cannot receive MP-AIX funding.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round31 October 2026, 23:59 Anywhere on Earth
LocationGermany

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://ai.mpg.de/how-to-join-phd

Source: ai.mpg.de - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 31 October 2026, 23:59 Anywhere on Earth - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Create an account in the joint ELLIS and MP-AIX application system as directed by the official call.
  2. Upload a two-page motivation and research statement, CV and university transcripts; supplementary research material is optional.
  3. Submit and send reference requests by 31 October 2026; referees may upload their letters until 2 November.

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example
  • Studying in Germany: Tuition Fees, Living Costs and Funding

English language requirements

German doctoral employment generally has no fixed IELTS or TOEFL threshold; your English is judged from the written application and the interview, and prior English-medium study is widely accepted as evidence.
